title: Arithmetic of Duality Defects in 4d Maxwell Theory
summary: We study the arithmetic structure of non-invertible duality defects in 4d $U(1)$ Maxwell theory. First, we recast the problem of realizing an elliptic $SL(2,\mathbb{Q})$ transformation as a duality defect in terms of complex multiplication for two-tori. The resulting classification includes well-studied cases in the literature, but extends to infinite Diophantine families of defects at a given gauge coupling.
